top_news.title: Containers - New scheduling policy for Containers to configure image and instance from Durable Objects
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Containers now support a durable_object scheduling policy, allowing runtime selection of image and instance size.
top_news.brief: The new policy enables Durable Objects to dynamically choose container configurations rather than relying on static, centrally managed settings. Developers can define multiple named images in Wrangler to facilitate this runtime flexibility.

top_news.title: Anthropic says Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude Mythos Preview at building exploits
top_news.dek: Anthropic reports that Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 model demonstrates cyber-exploit capabilities nearly matching its own Claude Mythos Preview.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's research indicates that GLM-5.3 can generate functional exploits, marking a significant jump in capability over previous open models. While Anthropic restricts access to Mythos to vetted defenders, GLM-5.3 is widely available, raising concerns about the proliferation of advanced cyber-attack tools.

top_news.title: Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team
top_news.dek: Anthropic's internal benchmarks show GLM-5.3 successfully executing control flow hijacks in 4% of trials.
top_news.brief: While Claude Mythos Preview outperformed GLM-5.3 at 6% success, the results confirm that GLM-5.3 has crossed a critical threshold for automated exploit generation. Previous models like Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2 failed to achieve any successful hijacks in the same test set.

top_news.title: Liquid AI Releases d1: A Decision Model That Returns Calibrated Probabilities With Zero Output Tokens
top_news.dek: Liquid AI's new d1 model provides calibrated probabilities for classification tasks without generating output tokens.
top_news.brief: Designed for structured decision-making rather than text generation, d1 is optimized for tasks like ticket routing, moderation, and reranking. By returning probabilities directly, it offers a more efficient alternative to general-purpose LLMs for classification workflows.

top_news.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
top_news.dek: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.1 Sol, offering near-Astra performance at 20% of the cost.
top_news.brief: GPT-6.1 Sol targets agentic coding and professional tasks with significant price reductions. Cached input costs are set at $0.10 per million tokens, representing a 95% discount over standard input pricing, aimed at supporting high-context agentic workflows.

primary.title: Google Research Open-Sources RRSI: AI Agents That Improve Their Own Harness Without Overfitting
primary.summary: Google Cloud AI Research has open-sourced RRSI, a framework that lets LLM agents rewrite their own prompts, tools and memory while model weights stay frozen. It adds a leakage critic, a noise floor, a cost rule and pruning so gains carry over to new tasks. With Claude Opus 4.8, Terminal-Bench 2.1 rose from 74.2% to 80.2%, and all 6 held-out splits improved.
